analogy.rationale: SLC12A1/2/4/5 are sodium/potassium/chloride cotransporters, so inhibitors of these transporters (including the related sodium/potassium/chloride transporter inhibitor class) should share downstream ion-transport and cell-volume responses; CFTR and GPR35 are poorly expressed in most of these lines, so overall transcriptional response is expected to be weak.
